blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several Southeast Asian civil society organizations (CSOs) called on member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to adopt immediate reforms to ensure sustainable public financing and equitable access to universal health care (UHC) Led by the Social Watch Philippines (SWP), more than 40 CSOs across the region emphasized that while the Philippines enacted the UHC law, “its core principles are being bastardized by the state’s chronic underfunding, budget diversions, vulnerability to corporate interests, and a fundamental lack of understanding of the role of social health insurance.” This problem, it said, has left out-of-pocket healthcare spending […]...
